name: Monochrome
description: Locked tabs, new tabs at the top, a ⌃Tab switcher, mini browsers and a sidebar player for Chrome, with the Monochrome helper app.

close-tab.description: Close tab (locked tabs come back at their locked URL)

reset-tab.description: Reset pinned tab to its pinned URL

recent-next.description: Recently used tab: start (the helper sends this for the first Ctrl+Tab)

recent-continue.description: Recently used tab: keep going (the helper sends Ctrl+Shift+Period for more Ctrl+Tabs)

recent-prev.description: Recently used tab: step back (the helper sends this for Ctrl+Shift+Tab)

mini-new.description: New mini browser (Monochrome handles Option+Shift+N itself; this is the fallback, set its scope to Global)

mini-open.description: Mini browser: open in Chrome (Monochrome handles Command+O itself; this is the fallback)

mini-open-in.description: Mini browser: open in window or tab group… (Monochrome handles Shift+Command+O itself; this is the fallback)
